content: As of my last update in October 2023, the most recent Champions League final was held on June 10, 2023. Manchester City won the final by defeating Inter Milan 1-0. The match took place at the Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul, Turkey. For the most current information, I recommend checking the latest sports news or official UEFA Champions League updates.
